text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh? So this is camp, huh? Not bad. Kinda
got a nice vibe to it. I bet
it'd make for a
good photo shoot location!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Fashionably late, but, we can make
up for lost time, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer. I'm sorry she couldn't be
here earlier—schedules didn't
quite work
out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'm gonna drop my stuff off and get
changed.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Excuuuse me? I'll be ready in ten. Don't
underestimate how fast
models can get
changed.

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City! Make sure to wear plenty of
sunscreen, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, don't need to tell me twice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Gold City's summer training
begins.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
We're all supposed to cook today? Huh?
I've barely ever held a pan.
Whoa, nope,
nope, nope!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine! Just calm down. You know,
I've never seen you in such
a panic before.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
City! C'mon, it's a beautiful morning for
training!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, I'm so done. Anything but early
mornings... Nope, not
happening.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All right,
one more race! And this time I'm
winning!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
You're on,
but I'm not losing. I'll bet you
three premium carrots.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Someone's feeling feisty! I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After dinner, Gold City comes up to me
and says she wants to talk
outside.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'd just about given up on
coming here. With work and
more work, it
wasn't looking like I could make it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But, you helped me figure out a schedule,
and I told my manager how
I feel... And,
well, here I am.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me too. Really, I am... Before, I
probably would've just gotten
pissed and
complained about it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! Can you not?! But, well... I'm
thankful, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I got here late, but you've kept me busy,
and I've gotten a chance to
know the
others.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No one's quite what they seem, are they? I
guess I was judging others
by what was on
the surface, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, apparently there's going to be
like a festival nearby. Want
to check it
out? I bet we'll see a lot of different
faces!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's City! She's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: I, um... I-I'm a big fan!

text_block_list.name: Stall Staff
text_block_list.text: Here, take one. They're delicious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's popular,
all right. You can tell she's
used to the attention by the
way she
smiles at the people who come up to her.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: City, you're the best.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'd be really happy if you'd watch
me race too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, didn't think so many people would
recognize me here. Kinda
funny.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Which labor—modeling or racing? Hard to
tell which one they're
talking about. All I
really want people to notice is my
running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? As if.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Go for a run? Wait, like now?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sooo why exactly did you drag me out of the festival for this? I swear, I am never going to get you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hello?! Ugh, fine, whatever. Okay, here I
go...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She kicks up a sandstorm across the beach!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My time? Yep, about what I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? As if that's gonna change anything.
Whatever, here goes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives it another go, but this time...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ugh, don't you ever get tired? Oh
wait, back at the festival...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: City, you're the best.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I got this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something lights a fire under her feet,
and...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sets a new personal best for the
summer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew. You reminded me of that kid from the festival, and then my legs... they just, like, surged ahead.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What, like they give me the power to go
that extra distance? Well, in
that case...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What if I... take all the fans of my
modeling work, and get them to
come to
my races?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Geez, manipulative much? Using my fans like that. I knew there was an evil mastermind behind the mask.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But... Heh. I like it.
Most of my fans only
know me as a model, and
now I can show
them what I'm like on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then they'll see I'm not just some pretty
doll—I'm a champion!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, okay, you got me on board. If I
want to win, I'll need you
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So, uh... Let's keep it up, yeah? Partner.
